VTS Scoring Log

BioLongevity Labs

US-based vendor· Scored August 2026· biolongevitylabs.com

BioLongevity Labs operates what it describes as the only triple third-party testing protocol in the research peptide space: every batch passes through three separate certified laboratories before shipment. SafeCert Labs (CLIA-certified) is named as one testing partner. Full analytical dossiers are publicly accessible at biolongevitylabs.com/all-coas before purchase, covering HPLC, LC-MS, sterility, endotoxin, residual solvents, and heavy metals. The documentation scope is the most complete in the current VTS roster.

94 /100
High Transparency
Triple third-party testing (three separate certified labs including SafeCert Labs CLIA), full pre-purchase COA database, most complete analytical dossier reviewed. The highest-scoring vendor on the current roster.

Scoring Notes
Triple third-party verification - differentiated architecture
BioLongevity Labs tests each batch at three distinct points in the supply chain using three separate certified labs. SafeCert Labs (CLIA-certified) is named as one testing partner. Multi-lab redundancy is the highest verification density documented on the current VTS roster and is meaningfully harder to fabricate than a single-lab COA.
COA database is vendor-hosted, not lab-server verifiable
COAs are comprehensive and publicly accessible but resolve to BioLongevity's own site rather than to individual lab portals. An outsider cannot independently verify a specific result against the testing lab's own database. This is the primary gap between 94 and a theoretical maximum.
APA membership - process signal, not product certification
American Peptide Association membership is documented. The APA promotes compliance and responsible research peptide practices. Membership is a process signal - it reflects commitment to industry standards but does not certify individual product batches.
